Adopt structured ethical data frameworks such as FAIR and CARE for data use when regulatory oversight is limited.
Publicly share data sources, model methodologies, and bias mitigation strategies, using tiered-access models for sensitive data.
Provide plain-language summaries of ML models and their risks and biases for nontechnical stakeholders and the public.
Invest in capacity building in LMICs, such as mentorship, open educational resources, and shared technical resources led by local stakeholders.
Establish accreditation or certification programs for public health ML applications requiring adherence to ethical and transparency standards.
